active.detailsHtml: Power BI customers may experience issues while refreshing Gen1 Dataflows. Refresh operations may remain stuck in an "In Progress" state. Mitigation has been successfully applied to several affected clusters and activities remain in progress for the remaining impacted clusters. The next update will be provided by 2026-08-09 14:00 PM PDT.
